description: Land Title Settlement Department - Sippikulama, Hambanthota D/S Division, Hambanthota District - Cad. Map No. 830111
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels (with parcel numbers, extents, and ownership details) in Sippikulama village, including declarations about title determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement. The content focuses entirely on land ownership, title registration, and property matters, fitting squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4).
